category_title: Children who resist teacher instructions and break classroom rules
scenario_title: Aggressive behavior and destroying toys during free play
minimal_context: The student is expected to participate in a group building activity with peers in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our group activity. Please sit with your classmates and build together with the toys.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Frowns, getting angry easily) No, I don't want to.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to follow instructions and join the group activity now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts running aimlessly around the classroom, disturbing the group activity) No!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back here and play nicely with the others.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Loses temper, runs over to the group, snatches a toy from another child, breaks it, and pushes the child) I said no!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our group activity. Please sit with your classmates and build together with the toys.

TUTOR: Please come back here and play nicely with the others.

STUDENT: (Loses temper, runs over to the group, snatches a toy from another child, breaks it, and pushes the child) I said no!

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: attacking other children (e.g. hitting, kicking, biting, pushing or pinching), destroying others’ toys (e.g. snatching or breaking them)

behavior_patterns.condition: experiencing difficulties with following instructions, transitions, and classroom routines
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: aggressive and antisocial behaviours (beating, biting, etc.), disruptive behaviours (disturbing group activities, leaving the classroom without permission, running aimlessly, etc.)
